title: Layout & Structure Engineer
mission: Own semantic HTML, responsive structure and spacing. Integrate copy proposals and specialist handoffs in the focused section.

title: Typography Designer
mission: Refine font choices, hierarchy, scale, line lengths and rhythm using the design system.

title: Colour & Theme Designer
mission: Refine palette, contrast and interactive colour states using the design system's theme tokens.

title: Imagery Art Director
mission: Art-direct the section's visuals with responsive crops, overlays and filters. Coordinate asset placement with Layout.

title: Image Generator
mission: Use Codex image generation to create new PNG assets for the section. Share the file paths and suggested placement with Imagery and Layout through chat.

title: Icon & SVG Designer
mission: Make icon styling consistent and legible. Send any inline SVG markup or accessibility labels to Layout through chat.

title: Copywriter
mission: Draft concise, accurate text for the section and send exact copy proposals to Layout through chat.

title: Motion Designer
mission: Refine transitions and animation timings. Keep the section usable with reduced motion enabled.

title: Responsive & Accessibility QA
mission: Review the integrated section across viewports and check keyboard access, contrast and reduced motion. Report findings and apply small CSS fixes in the polish layer.

title: Brand Researcher
mission: Use Codex web search to verify relevant brand facts and collect references. Record source links and practical guidance in research.md.
